description: This file defines a service function getNewUsersOverTime for aggregating new user creation counts over time with support for day, week, and month granularities. It interacts with a User model, performs MongoDB aggregations, and includes helper functions for date bucketing.

methods.name: getNewUsersOverTime
methods.description: Aggregates user creation counts over a specified time range with configurable granularity (day, week, month).

methods.name: fillMissingBuckets
methods.description: Fills in missing time buckets between start and end dates, ensuring continuous data points for the specified granularity.

methods.name: setToStartOfDayUTC
methods.description: Sets a date object to the start of the day in UTC.

methods.name: startOfMonthUTC
methods.description: Returns a date object representing the start of the month in UTC for a given date.

methods.name: startOfISOWeekUTC
methods.description: Returns a date object representing the start of the ISO week (Monday) in UTC for a given date.

methods.name: pad2
methods.description: Pads a number with leading zero if necessary to ensure two-digit format.

methods.name: weekNumberISO
methods.description: Calculates the ISO week number and year for a given date.

methods.name: formatISOWeek
methods.description: Formats a week start date into ISO week string (e.g., '2024-W01').
